subject: Legal Studies

internalBreakdown.component: Project: preparation and presentation of file
Project: understanding and application of legal concepts

notes: No chapter-level learning outcomes are given; course competencies: identify legal issues, apply law, legal research, legal values.

chapters.name: Concept of State
topics: What a state is; the state and Article 12
What government is; emergence of the state from society
Definition, theories of origin, elements and role of the state

chapters.name: Forms and Organs of Government
topics: Functions of the legislature, executive and judiciary

chapters.name: Separation of Powers
topics: Montesquieu's doctrine: features, checks and balances, impact
Benefits and defects of the doctrine
Separation of powers in Britain, the USA and India

units.name: Basic Features of the Constitution of India

chapters.name: Salient Features of the Constitution of India
topics: Preamble; fundamental rights, directive principles and fundamental duties; amendment
Adult suffrage, single citizenship, independent judiciary, emergency provisions
Federal in form, unitary in character; centre-state relations; schedules

chapters.name: Administrative Law
topics: Administrative and constitutional law: key differences
Reasons for growth of administrative law

units.name: Jurisprudence, Nature and Sources of Law

chapters.name: Jurisprudence, Nature and Meaning of Law
Sources of Law
topics: Custom and its importance in India

chapters.name: Law Reform
topics: Law reforms in India; recent reforms

chapters.name: Cyber Laws, Safety and Security in India
topics: Need for cyber laws; cyber safety and security

units.name: Judiciary: Constitutional, Civil and Criminal Courts and Processes

chapters.name: Judiciary: Constitutional, Civil and Criminal Courts and Processes
topics: Establishment of the Supreme Court and High Courts; independence and impartiality
Structure and hierarchy of courts; civil process and civil courts
Legal terminology; jurisdictions; res subjudice and res judicata (CPC 1908)
Criminal courts: types of offences, FIR, investigation and prosecution, autrefois acquit and convict, role of police

chapters.name: Institutional Framework: Marriage and Divorce
topics: Nature of family laws in India; human rights and gender perspective
Family courts: role of women, lawyers and counsellors

chapters.name: Child Rights
topics: Rights to education, health and shelter
Child labour; sexual abuse; juvenile justice
